tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) a weapon
1a) perhaps a lance, javelin

strongs_1890.derivation: or שִׁרְיֹן; and שִׁרְיָן; also (feminine) שִׁרְיָה; and שִׁרְיֹנָה; from H8281 (שָׁרָה) in the original sense of turning;
strongs_1890.kjv_def: breastplate, coat of mail, habergeon, harness. See H5630 (סִרְיֹן).
